description: Defines a template class Interval<T> representing a half-open interval with operations such as containment, intersection, union, and difference. Includes detailed comments, examples, and implementation of methods.

classes.name: Interval<T>
classes.description: A data structure representing a half-open interval [min, max) over an ordered type T, with methods for containment, intersection, union, and difference.

methods.name: Interval(const T& min, const T& max)
methods.description: Constructs an interval [min, max). If min >= max, the interval is empty.

methods.name: min()
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the interval.

methods.name: max()
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the interval.

methods.name: SetMin(const T& t)
methods.description: Sets the minimum value of the interval.

methods.name: SetMax(const T& t)
methods.description: Sets the maximum value of the interval.

methods.name: Set(const T& min, const T& max)
methods.description: Sets both min and max of the interval.

methods.name: CopyFrom(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Copies another interval into this one.

methods.name: Equals(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Checks if this interval is equal to another.

methods.name: Empty()
methods.description: Checks if the interval is empty (max <= min).

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the interval (max - min), zero if empty.

methods.name: Contains(const T& t)
methods.description: Checks if a point t is within the interval.

methods.name: Contains(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Checks if this interval fully contains another interval.

methods.name: Intersects(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Checks if this interval intersects with another.

methods.name: Intersects(const Interval& i, Interval* out)
methods.description: Checks intersection with another interval and outputs the intersection.

methods.name: IntersectWith(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Modifies this interval to be its intersection with another.

methods.name: SpanningUnion(const Interval& i)
methods.description: Expands this interval to include another, if necessary.

methods.name: Difference(const Interval& i, Interval* lo, Interval* hi)
methods.description: Calculates the difference between this and another interval, outputting up to two intervals.
